test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) Some drinks are juices.

2) Some juices are sodas.

3) All sodas are cocktails.

**Conclusions:**

I. No drink is a soda.

II. At least some juices are cocktails.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given statements:

Some drinks are juices.

 Some juices are sodas.

 All sodas are cocktails.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08f382685a8d6dc984250d22afbdb981a652bd36f303197e18c90d7ab7703814.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No drink is a soda - False (There is no direct relation between drink and soda, so it may be a possible case but not definitely true)

II. At least some juices are cocktails - True (Some juice are soda and all part of soda is cocktail, so the conclusion follows)

So,** Only conclusion 2 follows.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1."**
